summary: Extracted dashboard, reporting, export, access-control, integration, performance, mobile, deadline, and stakeholder-preference items. Extraction is partial because refresh requirements conflict, API-call minimization conflicts with five-second refresh, architecture preferences require reconciliation, and several open questions and incomplete fragments remain unresolved.
